headline: Google Extends Voluntary Buyout Offers to Employees in Several Countries
summary: Google began offering voluntary exit packages to employees in several countries following an initiative launched earlier in the year.
why: Corporate restructuring and voluntary severance programs can indicate cost-management strategies and operational efficiency drives within major technology firms.

impacts.name: Google
impacts.why: The voluntary buyout program directly affects Google's workforce and operational cost structure.
